product_metadata.title: YMGifts Picture Pillow Custom Pet Pillow Dog Pillows Gift (14", Colorful)
features: SIZE Available - 12 inches, 14 inches, 16 inches, 20 inches, 24 inches.
Measurement - Measurement size is based on the longest side of the pet and depends on purchased size. Short side is based on the size of the photo provided
QUALITY -Pillows are constructed of super soft suede for cover - printed double side(Front side and Back side are same)

CUSTOMIZATION - Please be sure photo is high quality,not less than 2000 px. Each photo will be edited to remove as much as the background as possible so the focus is on your furry friend. Photos of your pet sitting or standing with nothing blocking any part of their body looks best with these pillows.
Make it your own - Each personalized pet photo pillow is cut out to the shape of your beloved pet. Perfect for Animals lover gift, photo pillow,Christmas gift, pet lover gift.
